rule: is_used == True and is_new == False (NaN counts as unconfirmed)
reason: new cars, pre-registered/demo cars and records without a confirmed used flag
offer types other than 'U' (used) are unconfirmed

rule: body_type not in ['box', 'flatbed van', 'flatbed+tarpaulin', 'panel van', 'transporter', 'van-high roof']
reason: commercial body types listed under vehicle_type=Car

rule: price is numeric and not null
drop repeated (valid VIN, price, mileage, registration_date, country)
reason: identical listings re-posted under a different id
